<function=python>
<parameter=code>
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def extent(ch,r0,r1,c0,c1):
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if r<len(a) and c<len(a[r]) and a[r][c]==ch]
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),len(cells))
ball=extent('Y',10,20,25,40)
cup=extent('Y',30,40,25,40)
print("ball",ball,"cup",cup)
br=(ball[0]+ball[1])//2; bc=(ball[2]+ball[3])//2
print("ball center",br,bc)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':br,'col':bc}])
def desc(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    ys=[(n['boundary'][0],n['pixels']) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='Y']
    bar=sum(1 for ch in fr.ascii.split('\n')[1] if ch=='b')
    return dict(bar=bar,Y=ys)
print("after ball-center click:",desc(current_frame),"go",last_action_result.get('game_over'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
